heading: “Nuclear explosive device” defined
lead: As used in this subchapter, the term “nuclear explosive device” has the meaning given that term in section 6305(4) of this title.

notes.text: Effective DateSection effective 60 days after Apr. 30, 1994, see section 831 of Pub. L. 103–236, set out as a note under section 6301 of this title.
